text.autoconfig.stevehud.title: SteveHUD Settings
text.autoconfig.stevehud.option.hudEnabl: Whether SteveHUD draws the match graphics package inside the game at all.
text.autoconfig.stevehud.option.hudScale: An extra scale on top of the package's own. Each element scales about its own corner, so what is pinned top-right stays top-right.
text.autoconfig.stevehud.option.hudOpaci: Overall opacity of the in-game HUD, multiplied by the per-element opacity the layout sets.
text.autoconfig.stevehud.option.announce: Prints one line in chat when a SteveHUD server is reached. Useful while setting a match up; turn it off for a clean broadcast.
text.autoconfig.stevehud.option.verboseL: Logs every message the server sends, not just the handshake. Very noisy; for diagnosing a link that will not come up.
text.autoconfig.stevehud.option.localSer: Serve the overlay on this machine
Runs the local HTTP server that OBS browser sources and the layout editor connect to. The overlay and the in-game HUD share one layout file.
Port for the local graphics server. Point OBS at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/overlay/; the editor is at /editor/.
text.autoconfig.stevehud.option.bindLoop: Restricts the server to 127.0.0.1. Leave this on unless another machine genuinely needs the overlay; turning it off exposes the match data to your network.
stevehud.command.layout.scope_server: [SteveHUD] The server-wide package is in effect (set by %s): the in-game HUD and the overlays all draw it. Edits to the local package will not show until an operator clears it.
stevehud.command.layout.scope_local: [SteveHUD] The local package is in effect: it drives only this machine's HUD and overlay, affects nobody else, and needs no permission.
stevehud.command.layout.shadowed: [SteveHUD] Note: the local package was switched, but a server-wide package is in effect, so nothing on screen will change yet.
